# A plausible vanId is echoed back as matched, existent or not

**Claim.** The vanId in the body is never checked against the database: any id in the range this database has ever assigned answers 302 Matched with the id echoed straight back, even when it names no one — the Location it points at answers 404. Nothing is created.

Applies to: `~1people~1create/post`

## Observed exchange

_An id in the assigned range that names no person._

```http
GET /people/100777777

→ 404
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "NOT_FOUND",
      "text": "The specified resource cannot be found."
    }
  ]
}
```

_Create with that id: matched, apparently._

```http
POST /people/create

{
  "vanId": 100777777,
  "firstName": "Phantom"
}

→ 302
  Location: https://api.securevan.com/v4/people/100777777
{
  "vanId": 100777777,
  "status": "Matched"
}
```

_But the person the Location points at still does not exist._

```http
GET /people/100777777

→ 404
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "NOT_FOUND",
      "text": "The specified resource cannot be found."
    }
  ]
}
```
